description: Erection of a single storey rear extension and installation of new window to side elevation of ground floor flat
decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (LaVaastu/2019/194/01, LaVaastu/2019/194/02, LaVaastu/2019/194/03, LaVaastu/2019/194/04, LaVaastu/2019/194/05 & LaVaastu/2019/194/06, received on 14/11/19) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the building and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
